lee (PM): quick thread — need to finalize invoke scheduling & prioritization for multi-integration toolchains. customer asks: run multiple tool calls in parallel, control ordering for critical steps, define retries/timeouts, and clarify SLAs. target: ship proposal for Eng review by Tue. Launch criteria: API + SDK contract, sim tests, e2e regressions, and docs/FAQ.

 tim (eng): high-level Q: do customers want guaranteed ordering across parallel calls or only when they opt-in? ordering impacts latency/cost.

 sasha (eng): propose two modes: "concurrent_best_effort" and "ordered_transactional". concurrent_best_effort = fanout calls, merge responses, best-effort ordering; ordered_transactional = sequence or coordinated commit with abort on failure. Example proto:
```
multi_invoke: {
  mode: "concurrent_best_effort" | "ordered_transactional",
  concurrency: 4,
  per_call_timeout_ms: 6000,
  retry_policy: { max_retries: 2, backoff_ms: 200 }
}
```

 marco (solutions): for FinOps customers the priority is cost + predictability: they want 95th p latency SLO and controllable concurrency. also many integrations can accept first-success semantics (race) vs merge.

 tim (eng): SLA note: ordered_transactional requires distributed locks or coordinator; will increase p95 by ~20-40ms and adds failure modes. Need will affect Dedicated vs Hosted pricing tiers.

 sasha (eng): proposed API surface change for chat/tool_call: add optional "invoke_schedule" field with {strategy, ordering_hint, timeout_ms, retries}. Backward compatible: default stays single-tool semantics.

 lee (PM): good. can we make launch criteria explicit? 1) Spec doc, 2) SDK changes (py/js), 3) perf benchmarks for both modes, 4) migration path + gating (feature flag), 5) customer beta.

 infra-bot: Ticket created: PROJ-4321 - multi-invoke scheduling spec. Priority: P2. Assignee: sasha.

 marco (solutions): I'll draft beta FAQ and three customer scenarios (race, aggregate, transactional). want to sync Wed 10am.

 lee (PM): thanks — i'll schedule Wed 10 and add a short agenda: spec decisions, SLA impact, rollout plan. Assigning follow-ups: sasha spec, tim perf estimates, marco customer docs.

 tim (eng): noted. I'll run a quick simulation and post numbers before Wed.

 sasha (eng): will push spec draft to the repo by EOD Monday and include example calls + error semantics.

 lee (PM): perfect. closing loop here. :thumbsup:
